issue.title: Correct visual PNG tolerance guidance in build_and_run memory
issue.description: The audited build_and_run memory claims CI allows a small ratio-only renderer drift tolerance for PNG snapshots, but the current CI visual lane uses the default exact comparison with allowed: 0 pixels. This misleads agents debugging visual-test failures.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Update the PNG snapshot guidance to say CI uses exact PNG comparison unless an explicit SASE_VISUAL_PNG_* tolerance is configured; remove the claim that CI generally allows a small ratio-only renderer drift tolerance. Then run the required sase memory init regeneration after owner-approved memory edit.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced 2026-09-18 at f7ea41d3b2 during TUI screenshot-lint research: lint_and_test.md (PNG Snapshot Tests section, post-migration home of the build_and_run paragraph) still claims CI allows a small ratio-only renderer drift tolerance.
